questions.question: What percentage of children born in 2016 received the full series of the Hib vaccine by age 24 months for the total population?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
hib_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Hib', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
total_idx = df.iloc[hib_idx:].loc[df.iloc[hib_idx:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Total')].index[0]
val = float(df.iloc[total_idx, 7])
result = int(val) if val.is_integer() else val

questions.question: For children born in 2016, what was the percentage point gap in 4-dose DTaP vaccination coverage between children at or above the poverty level and those below poverty?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
dtap_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('DTaP', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
sub_df = df.iloc[dtap_idx:dtap_idx+20]
below = float(sub_df[sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Below poverty')].iloc[0, 7])
above = float(sub_df[sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('At or above poverty')].iloc[0, 7])
result = round(above - below, 1)

questions.question: In which birth year between 2010 and 2016 was the total national coverage rate for the combined 7-vaccine series at its lowest?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
series_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Combined 7-vaccine', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
total_idx = df.iloc[series_idx:].loc[df.iloc[series_idx:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Total')].index[0]
vals = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[total_idx, 1:8])
min_col = vals.idxmin()
result = str(df.iloc[4, min_col]).strip()

questions.question: Among racial and ethnic groups with reportable estimates, which two groups had the highest vaccination coverage for 3 or more doses of polio vaccine among children born in 2016?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
polio_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Polio', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
sub_df = df.iloc[polio_idx+2:polio_idx+10].copy()
sub_df = sub_df[pd.to_numeric(sub_df[7], errors='coerce').notna()]
sub_df['val'] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[7])
top2 = sub_df.sort_values(by='val', ascending=False).head(2)
result = top2[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: Across the birth cohorts from 2010 through 2016, what was the average coverage rate for 2 or more doses of the Hepatitis A vaccine in the total child population, rounded to two decimal places?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
hep_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Hepatitis A', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
total_idx = df.iloc[hep_idx:].loc[df.iloc[hep_idx:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Total')].index[0]
vals = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[total_idx, 1:8])
result = round(float(vals.mean()), 2)
